_comment: Checkout settings. Amounts in US dollars. carb_restricted_states: states where catalytic converters that aren't CARB-approved (emissions 'federal_only') can't be shipped. automatic_tax needs Stripe Tax turned on in the Stripe dashboard first. interactive_garage: the Interactive Garage vehicle builder shown on My Garage (empty url hides it).

installers._comment: Nearby repair shops from Google Maps (needs GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY). categories: top-level categories whose parts usually need a shop. survey_days: days after shipping to email the install survey.
installers.disclaimer: These shops are independent businesses found on Google Maps. They are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partners of Dream Auto Builders. Please confirm pricing, availability and that they install this type of part before booking.

cart_recovery._comment: Abandoned checkout recovery through Stripe. hours: how long the Stripe payment page stays open (1-23) before it counts as abandoned. email: send the 'You left something in your cart' email to shoppers who ticked Stripe's marketing-email box. allow_promotion_codes: let the reopened checkout accept promotion codes created in Stripe.

shipping._comment: carrier: 'ups' for live UPS prices at checkout (the exact UPS price, needs the UPS_ settings in Render), or 'flat' for free_shipping_over / flat_shipping. from_zip: the supplier warehouse ZIP parts ship from; brand_from_zip: {brand id: ZIP} for brands that ship from somewhere else. services: UPS service codes offered, in order (03 Ground, 12 3 Day Select, 02 2nd Day Air, 13 Next Day Air Saver, 01 Next Day Air; at most 5). fallback: prices used if UPS doesn't answer. default_weight_lb / default_dims: for parts with no weight or box size.
